subject: Casey REAS accession lot 6529NM.2026.001
method: Independent exact-head reviewers inspected the seven official Art Blocks generator responses, recomputed the reported response-body SHA-256 digests, reviewed dependency declarations and implemented controls, and compared their findings with the accession records.
hash_semantics: Each response_sha256 is an independently reviewed digest of the official generator HTTP response body observed during technical review. The response bytes were not retained because their transfer framing was rejected by the repository safe-fetch policy; these hashes are therefore attested observations, not substitutes for autonomous software preservation.
preservation_boundary: The transcript makes the reviewed technical findings reproducible from a source independent of the record constructor. It does not make the generator byte streams reproducible; exact generator, project-script, dependency, and render-environment capture remains active stewardship.
rooms_edition_statement: The retained population snapshot establishes 924 tokens and invocations 0–923. Invocation 0 is separately coded 999999; invocations 1–923 follow the documented combinatorial sequence. The reviewed generator contains the same 924-entry table. Native token #713 is invocation 713 and maps to Code 555536. This resolves the numerical structure but does not assign an artistic interpretation to invocation 0.
